inference.cluster_policy: Resample all eleven nested-p observations for one fresh seed as a complete trajectory, independently within L=11 and L=13. Forty clusters at 100 shots each preserve 4000 shots/cell while doubling independent trajectory count relative to the previous wave.
inference.crossing_policy: Retain no-crossing and multiple-crossing outcomes. Quote a conditional central 90% interval only with topology support and compare it against the previous fresh L11/L13 wave without pooling cohorts.
inference.cell_sign_policy: Classify the L11/L13 LER difference only when its central 90% seed-trajectory bootstrap interval excludes zero.
inference.selection_rationale: The dense common p=0.39:0.01:0.49 grid brackets the q=0.85 crossing near 0.414, resolves the q=0.90 ceiling-adjacent crossing near 0.483, and repeats the q=0.95 high-p sign test. A common grid preserves complete nested trajectories and avoids post-outcome p selection.
inference.reproducibility_gate: A crossing or ceiling label must reproduce the previous wave's qualitative topology and satisfy the registered 90% sign/topology rules in this independent 40-cluster cohort. Discordance remains unresolved rather than being pooled away.
inference.promotion_gate: Do not promote p_c(q), q_c, add q=0.925, reveal L15, or start square unless the independent confirmation passes its reproducibility and central-90% gates.

provenance_policy: Every shard must use one identical runtime/source cohort and pass raw-count, gzip/SHA-256, syndrome-fidelity, configuration, and start/end source-stability checks. This 40-cluster confirmation is never pooled with earlier discovery or refinement cohorts.
execution_gate: Passed 29/29 runner, dispatcher, analyzer, recovery, cap-diagnostic, scaling, and adaptive-confirmation tests plus a three-job dry run on 2026-08-28. Production may start; every shard remains fail-closed on syndrome fidelity and source stability.
purpose: Smallest common-grid confirmation that simultaneously increases independent trajectory count, refines the two finite-like crossing regions, and tests the unresolved q=0.95 high-p sign under the frozen primary decoder.
